findings: Enums unused in model annotations — role_type: str and camera_angle: str accept any string; import RoleType / CameraAngle into the model files and change the field types to enforce validation.

ShotUnit non-deterministic seed — random.randint on every call makes per-shot re-generation irreproducible. Use a deterministic seed derived from shot_id (e.g. hash(shot_id) & 0x7FFFFFFF) or add a user-configurable seed input.

ExpressionSheet disconnected in workflow template — Node 116's CHARACTER_ASSET input has link: null; add a link from node 115's character output (slot 0) to node 116's input so the template demonstrates the full cast→expression flow.

camera_angle is free-form in SYSTEM_PROMPT — The example shows free-form Chinese text with no whitelist constraint, unlike camera_motion. Downstream code will silently receive unstructured text. Add a constrained value list to the prompt.

CameraMotionEx/SYSTEM_PROMPT whitelist mismatch — crane_up, crane_down, handheld are defined in CameraMotionEx but absent from the SYSTEM_PROMPT allowed-values list. The LLM will never produce these values, making those enum members unreachable via the parser.
